name: academic-skill
description: Norwegian and English academic skills for assignments, research, writing, learning, presentations and final checks.

interface.longDescription: One general academic assistant and eleven independently selectable workflows for students. Interpret a rubric, revise a paragraph, check a source you provide, practise an oral exam or plan a timed presentation in Norwegian or English. File editing and external searches depend on the tools available in your session.
defaultPrompt: Turn my assignment and rubric into a plan.
Check my claims against the excerpt I provide.
Quiz me on my notes, one question at a time.
